abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, and MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE wrote combat.total_defense, which _resolve_damage recomputes from sum(card.defense) immediately before damage -- so the value was discarded even when something did set it. WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_DEFENSE with MODIFY_DEFENSE moves the DEFENDING CARD's own {d}, which is what survives into the total. CONTROLS_ATTACK_ACTION with cost_gte asked whether the controller HAS such a card, not whether the DEFENDER is one.

_comment: Deleted: an unconditional GAIN of Go Again on a card that PRINTS **Go again**. Printed keywords come from card data and already work, so this static was a duplicate of something that happens anyway -- and it was dead besides. Removed the original dead STATIC, which was left in place beside the WHILE_STATIC that replaced it -- a duplicate of the same clause, one live and one dispatched by nothing.
